artworks.label: Canvas field binoculars
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for olive-outpost. One exquisite pair of vintage unbranded field binoculars with matte dark-olive leather barrels, aged brass eyecups and central bridge, finely woven sandy canvas neck strap loosely curved below, soft cream lens reflections and a tiny pine needle fragment. High-end outdoor-equipment still-life macro photography, warm lantern-like side light, realistic leather/brass/cotton texture, olive/sand/brass/ivory palette. No gauges, numeric scales, radio, canteen, stove, clock or compass. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
